value.text: Florentine scheme to drain the marsh / canalise the Arno

claims.statement: RCT thinks the map was probably connected with a Florentine plan concerning the marshy lake of the Valdichiana, part of the scheme to canalise the Arno.

sources.cite: Royal Collection Trust, collection online, RCIN 912278, A map of the Valdichiana, c.1503 to 1506. Read through search engine excerpts in this session; the page itself was not fetched in this session.

value.text: Service of Cesare Borgia, after the Arezzo revolt of June 1502

claims.statement: Solmi (1912), as reported by RCT, linked the map to Borgia's service and the revolt of Arezzo in June 1502.

sources.cite: Royal Collection Trust, collection online, RCIN 912278, A map of the Valdichiana, c.1503 to 1506. Read through search engine excerpts in this session; the page itself was not fetched in this session.

value.text: Place names written left to right

claims.statement: RCT notes that all towns and rivers are labelled in the conventional direction, not in mirror script.

sources.cite: Royal Collection Trust, collection online, RCIN 912278, A map of the Valdichiana, c.1503 to 1506. Read through search engine excerpts in this session; the page itself was not fetched in this session.
